published_paper_10k_population.definition: 10,000 sequence and adjacency-matrix instances sampled from 172 Gene3D test superfamilies (Strokach et al., Cell Systems 2020 Figure 2B caption and Methods).
published_paper_10k_population.legacy_distribution_route_details: DNS resolves to 206.12.89.143. Port 80 redirects (301) to HTTPS. HTTPS port 443 returns TLS certificate expired (SEC_E_CERT_EXPIRED). Under TLS bypass (-k / verify=False), nginx returns HTTP 200 OK with directory listing. Candidate partition processed/test_data/ has 1,461 rows (1,420 valid). Root /test_data/ contains 172 unbundled superfamily directories without documented sampling seeds. Full 10,000-instance recovery is resource-bounded.
